name: ★ STACK · the R19 stand, resumed and left alone (watch)
hint: duck_r19_s2 under R19: tall, still (0.02 mrad/tick), zero falls, with or without the deployed servo filter.

name: PIPELINE (old lineage) 1/3 · find from scratch (R13, 2 h) — 1/6 seeds; the record of the pre-R19 path
hint: Design doc §12.3/§12.6. Seed 2 stands by ~30 min (falls 8 → 3 → 1 → 0/min); other seeds fall-cycle. Tick 'battery' with seeds 1-6 for the race. ≈ 380 MB of JSONL.

hint: Resume the find brain under R11: C norms shed, no falls, oscillation 12 → 11 mrad. Load-bearing — handing the find brain straight to R12c fails (§12.6).

hint: Resume the hunted brain under R12c: the efference rests at earned stillness, |dq| 11 → 0.1 mrad/tick, c 1.00. Watch it to see the oscillation stop.

name: PROBE · push test — 3 N shoves on the R19 stand every 60 s (watch)
hint: The (d) test on the current stand: 3 N is the edge (13/36 caught, fore-aft goes over); watch the ball go red, c dip to 0.90 and re-earn in ~20 s.

name: PROBE · envelope — 2 N shoves on a saved brain (the catch limit)
hint: R19 catches 2 N 35/36 and 3 N 13/36. Change the force to bracket a brain's envelope; Report reads it. Point 'a saved brain' at the brain under test.

hint: The guard: run it before touching code, keep the JSONL, run it again after, cmp.

name: PROBE · scaffold — shove Pollen's standing policy (5 N every 4 s, watch)
hint: The RL reference: staggers and catches 5 N, knocked over at 10 N and stands back up. The envelope the brain is measured against.

name: PROBE · recovery harness — the stub brain that falls over (watch)
hint: A brain that fails, the scaffold that picks it up, and the hand-off between them. Tests the harness, not the substrate.

name: ★ STACK · find from scratch (R19, 2 h, headless, saves the brain) — every seed stands in 15 min
hint: R19: a settle before every identification pulse window. All six seeds consolidate inside 15 min, 2-3 rescues in 2 h, tilt 0.35°, |u| 0.18; the brain catches 2 N shoves. Tick 'battery' for seeds 1-6.

name: ★ STACK · watch the catch — 2 N shoves on the R19 stand every 20 s (watch)
hint: Resume duck_r19_s2 under R19 and shove it: the ball stays green, tilt peaks ~2.7° and the body is back inside 0.6 s. Raise to 3 N to see where it still goes over (fore-aft first).

name: ★ STACK · the step — 3 N shoves on the R19 stand with the walker's hand-off (watch)
hint: Phase 0/1a of the intent boundary: when the brain's own attitude-prior error passes 0.06 and is rising, the joints go to the walker (yellow ball), which staggers through it, then back to the brain. Measured across six brains: 3 N 36/36 upright (13/36 without), 5 N 30/36 (6/36 without), never at 1 N, two false hand-offs in 36 at 2 N.

name: ★ STACK · a walk on request — 4 s forward at 0.3 m/s, then back to the reflex (watch)
hint: Phase 1b of the intent boundary: at 10 s the joints go to Pollen's walking policy with a forward command (blue ball), it walks ~0.5 m, settles, and hands back to the brain, which is quiet again within seconds. Change vx/vy/vyaw to steer; the policy stands still below ~0.25 m/s.

name: R20 · level-2 identification — twist babble at the walker (700 s, headless, saves the brain)
hint: Phase 1e of the intent boundary: the same module one level up. Motors = the three twist commands to Pollen's walker, senses = the body's own velocity from contact odometry and the gyro. Held 1.5 s twist pulses, one axis at a time. The host prints the identified A at the end: a positive, dominant diagonal is the gate (passed: 0.0083 / 0.0040 / 0.0090).

name: R21 · level-2 prior: walk straight — prior-only (HK on spins); 0.21 m/s, straightness 0.90 (headless, 1500 s)
hint: The first level-2 control (design doc §16.5): a state prior on the sensed forward velocity (slot 0, target 0.75 of the 0.4 m/s range = 0.3 m/s) and on the yaw rate (slot 6, target 0), with the controller learning (ctrl_lr 0.1) through the A that R20 identified. Babble 600 s, then the prior drives. Judged on forward speed and heading drift over the control phase against the walker under a constant forward command, which drifts 5-8 deg/s by itself.

name: R22 · level-2 heading regulation — shoves during the walk, the brain turns back (headless, 1500 s)
hint: The (d) test at the intent boundary (§16.6): after 600 s of babble the brain walks at the walker's top speed holding its heading; 2 N shoves every 40 s turn it 17-20°, and it is back within 3-4° twenty seconds later, 20/20, no rescues. The open-loop walker (--l2-twist 0.4 0 0) ends 109° off. Switch to watch to see it; the ball is blue while the walker drives.

name: R23 · level-2 avoidance in the arena — zero wall contacts, but an orbit (headless, 1500 s)
hint: Phase 2a: the ToF proximities enter the level-2 sense and a prior of zero on them plus the walk-forward prior gives 0 wall contacts in 25 min (open loop: 46/min; walk-straight: 194/min, pinned to a wall). But it orbits: 167 m inside nine 0.25 m cells. Avoidance is a constraint, not a drive — R24 adds the novelty drive. Watch it with scene_arena.xml; the beams draw from the head.
